title: Olympian choses Minnesota for best-in-nation academics and athletics
summary_en: For Josefin Bouveng — Swedish Olympian and Gopher hockey player — the University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering scores high for “great hockey program and great education.”

title: Three CSE students awarded Astronaut Scholarships
